title: docs: reconcile the sponsor listings with active sponsorships
body:
Brings both sponsor listings in line with the active GitHub sponsorships.

Removed from zod.dev, none of them sponsoring. Cancellation dates come from the sponsor activity feed; the active list is the ground truth, because a cancellation on its own doesn't mean churn — CodeRabbit and Storyblok both cancelled and re-subscribed on annual terms.

| Tier | Sponsor | Cancelled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gold | Neon | 2026-07-05 |
| Gold | Stainless | 2026-06-20 |
| Silver | Crypto Jobs List | 2026-09-08 |
| Silver | Nitric | 2026-09-08 |
| Silver | Cerbos | 2026-09-05 |
| Silver | Plain | 2026-07-21 |
| Silver | Ferry Health | 2026-06-01 |
| Silver | Sanity | never recurring — two one-time payments, last 2026-01-26 |
| Bronze | Clipboard | 2026-04-30 |

The other two commits:

- **Trigger.dev joins Platinum.** They opened a $999/mo sponsorship on 2026-09-08, having lapsed in 2024 and been pruned from Silver in 7391be88. That price is the platinum point — CodeRabbit was on it when added to the tier in c6a0ca3d, and the tiers below are $499 (Neon and Stainless, both Gold) and $249 (PropelAuth, 9thCO, Subtotal, all Silver). Uses their GitHub org mark, since they publish no light/dark wordmark pair.
- **The Zod 3 roster is 19 entries out of date.** `v3.zod.dev` serves `packages/docs-v3/home.md`, and it still advertised Courier, LibLab, Retool, Speakeasy, Infisical, Val Town, Encore, Replay, Numeric, Marcato Partners, Interval, Seasoned and Bamboo Creative alongside the nine above — its entire Gold tier was inactive. All 19 are gone. Zernio joins Gold so the tier isn't empty, Subtotal and 9thCO join Silver, Convex and n8n join Bronze, and Trigger.dev moves to Platinum. The two English pages now list the same sponsors at the same tiers, except that Route4Me stays on the Zod 3 page — they sponsor actively but have never been on the current one. Every kept entry's markup is untouched; only the row grouping is regenerated.

Two that look cancelled but aren't, and stay: Zernio has no GitHub Sponsors record at all, so it bills through the other channel; Cybozu points its logo at the `cybozu-sponsorship` account while the active sponsorship sits under `cybozu`.

Gold on zod.dev is down to one entry, so its grid stays single-column below two sponsors and the last cell drops its right border. Otherwise the lone card strands a divider down the middle.

The Korean and Chinese Zod 3 pages keep their own, older rosters. The Korean one still lists Clerk as Platinum and the Chinese one lists Astro and Trip, so they are snapshots of a different era rather than maintained listings.

One thing worth watching: CodeRabbit dropped from $999 to $499 in May and has a pending change dated 2026-09-04. Every other pending change in the feed was followed by a cancellation within a month.

reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The changes are straightforward content updates plus a small, self-contained layout tweak with no remaining references to the removed sponsors in `packages/docs`.
Pull request overview Updates the docs sponsor tier components to reflect the current active sponsor list by removing lapsed entries, and tweaks the Gold tier layout so a single remaining sponsor doesn’t render as an awkward two-column grid. **Changes:** - Removed lapsed Silver and Bronze sponsors from their respective `companies` lists. - Removed lapsed Gold sponsors and made the Gold grid responsive to the number of entries (only enabling 2 columns when there’s more than 1). - Adjusted Gold card border classes so the last card won’t render a right border.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/docs/components/silver.tsx | Removes several lapsed Silver sponsors from the rendered list | | packages/docs/components/gold.tsx | Removes Neon/Stainless and makes the Gold grid conditional on company count for better single-sponsor layout | | packages/docs/components/bronze.tsx | Removes Clipboard from the Bronze sponsor list |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 3/3 changed files - **Comments generated:** 0 - **Review effort level:** Lite

> [!IMPORTANT] > The current-site prune is correct, but the deployed Zod 3 site still advertises six sponsors this PR identifies as inactive. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the complete sponsor-tier diff and its deployed documentation context at `c77ab878`. - **Sponsor roster** — Removes Clipboard from Bronze, Neon and Stainless from Gold, and six inactive Silver sponsors; the removals match the audit in the PR body. - **Gold layout** — Keeps the lone remaining Gold card in one column and removes its stranded right border. ### ⚠️ The deployed Zod 3 sponsor roster remains stale The live `v3.zod.dev` homepage still lists Neon, Stainless, Nitric, Cerbos, CryptoJobsList, and Plain, even though this audit removes them from the current docs. The Korean Zod 3 page also retains five of those entries, so merging now leaves publicly served sponsor pages contradicting the active-sponsorship list.
Technical details ````markdown # Prune the deployed Zod 3 sponsor pages too ## Affected sites - [`packages/docs-v3/home.md:250`](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/blob/c77ab8780045f7785904ac9ded843c59f9dcf189/packages/docs-v3/home.md#L250-L373) — the deployed Docsify homepage contains all six stale entries - [`packages/docs-v3/README_KO.md:235`](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/blob/c77ab8780045f7785904ac9ded843c59f9dcf189/packages/docs-v3/README_KO.md#L235-L357) — the Korean page repeats all except Nitric - [`packages/docs-v3/index.html:287`](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/blob/c77ab8780045f7785904ac9ded843c59f9dcf189/packages/docs-v3/index.html#L287) — configures `home.md` as the live homepage ## Required outcome - Remove the same inactive sponsors from the deployed Zod 3 sponsor tables, or explicitly document why that live site intentionally preserves a historical sponsor roster. ````
